extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the Hertz Fellowship (graduate students/early-career researchers in science, engineering, and related fields)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for applying to the Hertz Fellowship, including timeline/deadlines, reference submission, interview stages, and information about benefits and recommenders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application timeline and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Key dates applicants must follow: Application Opens Aug 28, 2025; Information Sessions Sep 10 & Sep 16, 2025; Application Deadline Oct 31, 2025; Reference Deadline Nov 3, 2025; Application Preselection Nov 6–17, 2025; Round 1 Interviews Dec 12–15, 2025, Jan 9–10, 2026, Jan 16–17, 2026; Round 2 Interviews Feb 7–8, 2026 and Feb 21–22, 2026; Finalists Notified Feb 2026; Fellowship Recipients Notified April 2026; Fellowship Announcement May 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan your submission and reference collection around these fixed dates; prepare for multiple interview rounds and preselection windows. Use the timeline to schedule work, request letters well before the reference deadline, and attend information sessions if possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference (recommender) submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommenders from academia and industry are integral to the application; references must be submitted by the Reference Deadline (Nov 3, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notify and coordinate with recommenders early, provide them with submission instructions and deadlines. The site links to a 'for recommenders' resource for more detailed guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility / Who can apply (high-level mention)
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowship seeks the nation’s most promising talent from different disciplines, backgrounds, and points of view. (Page links to a separate 'Who Can Apply / see all criteria' resource.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the linked 'Who Can Apply' page for the full, specific eligibility criteria — this page only references that set of criteria rather than listing them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application submission channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are submitted through the Hertz Foundation application portal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the official application portal to submit materials; follow portal instructions and timelines. The page provides a link to the portal (applicants should confirm they are using the correct year/cycle portal).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process stages (preselection, interviews, finalist notification)
rubrics_metrics.description: The selection process includes an application preselection phase, multiple rounds of interviews (Round 1 and Round 2), finalist notification, and final fellowship recipient notification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should expect staged evaluation; being selected to interview is a required step toward finalist status. Prepare for interviews across the listed date ranges and understand that final decisions occur after second-round interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship benefits (funding duration and amount)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hertz Fellowship awards up to five years of funding, valued at up to $250,000, along with career support and mentorship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight in your application how the fellowship duration and funding will support your proposed graduate research and professional development; note additional non-financial benefits such as dedicated mentors and networking opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay informed / communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are encouraged to subscribe to email updates and may contact the fellowship team at fellowshipinfo@hertzfoundation.org for questions or updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe to receive application updates, information-session announcements, and timeline changes; use the provided contact email for application-specific questions.
